brand_identity.name: Ricky Suhas

headings.font_family: Cormorant Garamond, Bodoni Moda, or Serif Display

mono_data.usage: Coordinates, camera metadata (EXIF: 1/1000s, f/2.8, ISO 100, 24mm), GPS location labels, admin tags

spacing_and_layout.hero_height: min-h-screen relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
spacing_and_layout.bento_asymmetry: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (col-span-full md:col-span-8, col-span-4, col-span-12) for photography storyboards
spacing_and_layout.vertical_reels: Mobile card aspect ratio (aspect-[9/16]), smooth vertical swipe or horizontal wheel scroll with micro-audio toggle

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 (dark) or backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-black/10 (light)
visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Grainy ambient texture overlay with opacity-5 pointer-events-none to eliminate digital flatness
visual_enhancers.ambient_glow: Radial gradient blur effects behind high-res images and spatial map nodes
visual_enhancers.cursor_viewfinder: Custom interactive cursor with coordinate readouts or camera aperture ring effect on hover

motion_and_interactions.scrollytelling: Smooth momentum scrolling via Lenis, parallax camera zoom on scroll
motion_and_interactions.spatial_transitions: Framer motion scale-up layout transitions from thumbnail to spatial fullscreen viewer
motion_and_interactions.hover_previews: Video reel hover plays muted video snippet, photography hover shifts depth of field / scale
motion_and_interactions.map_camera_flyto: Interactive topographical region selection zooms into geographic coordinates smoothly

cinematic_hero.description: One dominant anchor visual with layered misty mountain image, atmospheric soundtrack toggle, quote 'Take a moment to enjoy God's creation', and live camera location metadata

spatial_map_explorer.description: Interactive Topographical Spatial Map with interactive location nodes (Western Ghats, Spiti Valley, Himalayas, Coastal Kerala, Wayanad, Kaziranga), work count, and region drill-down

photography_editorial_grid.description: Asymmetric editorial grid with 2-line rich descriptions, EXIF data drawer, spatial zoom viewer with prev/next keyboard/swipe navigation

cinematic_films.description: 4K cinematic film showcase with video player modal, spatial soundscapes, ambient canvas glow, and duration badges

vertical_reels.description: 9:16 vertical reels player with audio toggle, play/pause controls, captions, and mobile-like card slider

collections_explorer.description: Curated story collections: Western Ghats, Himalayas, Spiti Valley, Coastal Kerala with region tags and geographic coordinates

stories_journal.description: Photographer's journal/field notes detailing journeys, weather conditions, sacred moments, and percussion rhythms in nature

about_ricky.description: Editorial biography highlighting dual identity as Nature Visualist & Percussionist, philosophy, equipment loadout, and percussion instruments

social_hub.description: Live links and curated media cards for Instagram @rickysuhas, YouTube @Rickysuhas0110, and Facebook

admin_studio.description: Full-featured Admin CMS Dashboard with authentication (admin@rickysuhas.com / RickySuhas2026!), drag-and-drop single & bulk media upload, metadata batch tagging, published/draft status, place/collection manager, and site settings edit

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Ensure all interactive and key elements contain data-testid attributes for testing.
Do not use transparent header backgrounds without backdrop filter blur.
Always provide both light and dark modes with a smooth switcher in header/navigation.
Use exact admin credentials in pre-seeded database/state: admin@rickysuhas.com / RickySuhas2026!.
Incorporate 2-line descriptive captions for photography viewer as requested in problem statement.
Ensure spatial keyboard and swipe navigation work for full-screen photo modal.
